en.dr-ali-peiravi: 5-101 Yahya ibn Zayd ibn al-Ab’bas ibn al-Walid al-Baz’zaz in Kufa narrated that his uncle Ali ibn Ab’bas quoted Ibrahim ibn Boshr ibn Khalid al-Abdi, on the authority of Amr ibn Khalid, on the authority of Abi Hamzih al-Sumaly that Ali ibn al-Hussein (MGB) said, “
Fair speech increases wealth; increases sustenance; postpones death; creates love among family members; and causes the person to enter Heaven.”
